title: ConfirmationRequest
description: 'Is the fire still there?': the operator screen asks a crew near a reported fire, or a person in the area, to confirm it. The voice assistant turns question_code into a message or call in the target's language and answers with a ConfirmationResponse. People in danger are not called back for this.

report_id.description: The FireReport (or cluster of reports) to confirm.

ref.description: Crew id, or the caller's hashed number (sha256:...), never the number itself.

distance_m.description: Distance from the reported place when asked.

question_code.description: The voice assistant holds one template per code and language.

expires_at.description: No answer by then counts as unknown.

consent.description: The person agreed to be contacted again (GDPR / KVKK).

mock.description: Answered by the demo's mock, not sent to anyone.
